title: Mirabel and the Scholarship
author: Ivo Coldharbour
blurb: Tamsin Marchetti, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
